subtitle: Document Analysis
og_description: Upload a PDF and get an instant trust score. Detects metadata tampering, font inconsistencies, date anomalies and more.
twitter_description: Free online document analysis tool. Upload a PDF and get an instant trust score.
landing_tagline: Analyze your PDF documents in seconds and detect any trace of modification.
disclaimer_upload: PDF (up to 10 MB and 20 pages) or a photo of a 2D-Doc code. Your document is not retained.
disclaimer_api: Only the file hash and company identifiers (SIRET, VAT) may be sent to external APIs (VirusTotal, INSEE, VIES) to verify the document.
drop_pdf_here: Drop your PDF or a photo here
too_large_message: This file is {size} MB. TrustyFile accepts files up to 10 MB.
too_many_pages_message: This document has {count} pages. TrustyFile only analyzes documents up to 20 pages.
render_error_title: The result could not be displayed
render_error_message: An internal error occurred while displaying the analysis; it has been logged. Try again in a moment or with another document.
not_found_message: This address does not exist, or the result it showed has expired.
tip_stated_date: Date written in the document text (e.g. "Paris, le 06/01/2026")
tip_creation_date: Date the PDF file was originally generated by the software
tip_modification_date:
Date the PDF was last saved or edited.
Should be identical to creation date for untouched documents
pill_stated_tooltip: PDF created {days} days after the date stated in the document
score_caveat: A high score means few signs of manipulation; it does not guarantee the document is authentic. A low score deserves a manual check.
score_caveat_short: This result does not guarantee the document is authentic, TrustyFile can make mistakes.
next_step_GENUINE: If the stakes are high, confirm with the issuer.
next_step_REVIEW: Ask the issuer for an explanation or the original.
next_step_SUSPICIOUS: Do not rely on this document. Ask the issuer for the original.
next_step_UNVERIFIABLE: Ask for the original PDF, then run the analysis again.
next_step_GENUINE_proof: If the stakes are high, confirm with the issuing organisation.
next_step_REVIEW_proof: Ask for the original or check with the issuing organisation.
next_step_SUSPICIOUS_proof: Do not accept this document. Check it with the issuing organisation.
next_step_GENUINE_generic: If the stakes are high, confirm with the issuer.
next_step_REVIEW_generic: Ask the issuer for an explanation or the original.
next_step_SUSPICIOUS_generic: Do not rely on this document. Ask the issuer for the original.
batch_intro: One row per document; “Open” shows its full results page. Documents are not retained.
batch_too_many: Only the first {max} files of the batch are analysed.
batch_problem_not_a_pdf: The file could not be opened as a PDF.
batch_problem_photo: Photo: upload it on its own to read its 2D-Doc code.
photo_sig_valid: The issuer's signature is valid: the data below is exactly what the issuer signed.
photo_sig_invalid: The signature does not match the data: this code may have been altered or fabricated. Check the document with its issuer.
photo_sig_unconfirmed: The reading is not reliable enough to conclude. Retake the photo closer, flat and well lit.
photo_sig_test_cert: This code is signed with a test (specimen) certificate, not by an official issuer.
photo_sig_unverifiable: We cannot verify this issuer's signature. That says nothing about whether the document is genuine.
photo_no_code: Retake the photo closer to the code, sharp and well lit. Full photo analysis is not available yet: if you have the original PDF, upload it.
photo_unreadable: This file could not be opened as a photo (JPEG or PNG, 10 MB max).
photo_compare_warning: A valid signature proves this data comes from the issuer, not that the paper belongs to the applicant: check that the name and amounts match the document and the ID.
photo_fields_error: The code was read, but some fields could not be displayed.
photo_unsigned_fields: Data read from the code, not guaranteed: the signature could not be validated.
tip_modifications: Detects if the PDF was edited after creation
tip_consistency: Checks dates, amounts and references for contradictions
tip_tampering: Detects visual edits, font swaps and image manipulation
tip_authenticity:
Verifies the originator's identity (SIRET, VAT)
Internet connection needed
feedback_comment_placeholder: E.g. the document is genuine, the result is hard to understand…
feedback_privacy: We store your opinion and the analysis result, never your document.
detail_why_intro: Each bar shows how much one family of checks weighed on the score: the longer it is, the more it lowered it.
detail_points_intro: Most serious first. Click a line to see its raw data.
detail_file_intro: What we read in the document and in the PDF itself.
detail_tech_intro: The result of each check, as the engine produced it.
step1_desc: Drag and drop or browse your files
flag_check_tool: Re-check this number with the free tool
flag_read_guide: Understand this signal in the guide
demo_banner: Sample: a fictitious invoice, forged on purpose for this demo.
doctype_banner_technical: This document appears to be a technical specification or API documentation. TrustyFile is optimised for invoices and administrative documents. JavaScript and multiple revisions are normal for this document type.
doctype_banner_scientific: This document appears to be a scientific or academic paper. TrustyFile is optimised for invoices, certificates and attestations. Results may not be meaningful for this document type.
doctype_banner_legal_notice: This document appears to be a legal notice or terms and conditions. TrustyFile is optimised for invoices and administrative documents. Results may not be meaningful for this document type.
doctype_banner_unknown: The document type could not be determined. TrustyFile is optimised for invoices, certificates and attestations. Interpret these results with caution.
